event_chain.summary: About 30TB of documents and footage stolen

summary: In July 2026 the pro-Iran "Cyber Support Front" hacking group claimed an attack on IMCO, an Israeli supplier of electrical systems, battlefield computers and displays for armored vehicles and air defense platforms, saying it infiltrated communication networks, industrial infrastructure and storage and stole about 30TB including 10TB of military documents, manufacturing blueprints, contracts and facility surveillance footage. According to the report, IMCO acknowledged serious damage and set up a crisis team.
